# Lucas Barbosa

> The personal website of Lucas Barbosa, an engineer, researcher, and product designer writing about software, artificial intelligence, robotics, mathematics, science, startups, and life.

This site contains Lucas's biography, selected work, research, essays, notes, and worked solutions to technical problems. Use the writing and problem archives to discover individual entries. Unless a page states otherwise, Lucas Barbosa is the author.

## About

- [Home and biography](https://maybelucas.com/): Background, current work, selected projects, achievements, and contact links.
- [Research](https://maybelucas.com/research): Research interests, publications, and academic work.
- [Coding](https://maybelucas.com/coding): Programming experience, tools, and software interests.
- [Bookshelf](https://maybelucas.com/bookshelf): Books Lucas has read or recommends.

## Writing

- [Writing archive](https://maybelucas.com/writing): Complete, reverse-chronological index of essays with summaries and reading times.
- [The Hippocampus of AGI](https://maybelucas.com/writing/hippocampus): An essay on whether language models are AGI or one component of a larger system.
- [The Laws of Software](https://maybelucas.com/writing/software-laws): A collection of laws and principles from software engineering and computing.
- [Policy Gradients](https://maybelucas.com/writing/policy-gradients): A technical introduction to how reinforcement-learning agents learn by acting.
- [Zig Doesn't Need an FFI](https://maybelucas.com/writing/zig-interop): A practical exploration of interoperability between Zig and C.
- [On Research](https://maybelucas.com/writing/on-research): A short argument for ambitious, consequential research.

## Problems

- [Problems of the Day](https://maybelucas.com/problems): Index of worked programming and mathematics problems with topic, difficulty, and estimated solving time.
- [Disc Game Prize Fund](https://maybelucas.com/problems/disc-game-prize-fund): A probability dynamic-programming solution to Project Euler problem 121.
- [k-Tree](https://maybelucas.com/problems/k-tree): A dynamic-programming solution to Codeforces problem 431C.

## Other Collections

- [Questions](https://maybelucas.com/questions): Questions Lucas is thinking about, plus a link to the daily problem collection.
- [Musings](https://maybelucas.com/musings): Short observations and ideas.
- [Lexicon](https://maybelucas.com/lexicon): Words, phrases, and concepts collected by Lucas.
- [Lab](https://maybelucas.com/lab): Interactive experiments and prototypes.

## Optional

- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/lbxa): Lucas's public code and repositories.
- [Website source](https://github.com/lbxa/maybelucas.com): Source code and content for this website.
